results.content: Where Trump Is Most Popular According to the Civiqs poll, Trump has the highest net approval rating in Wyoming, where 56 percent of voters approve of his performance and 35 disapprove—giving him a net approval rating of +22 when rounding up. His net approval rating is also positive in several other states that make up the Republican heartland: In Indiana, Trump's net approval rating slipped underwater in Civiqs' polling in late June, after being positive throughout his second term.
